answer: Adaptive Vault Gate Sync. Each identity's first transactions must arrive through a per-cycle ingress window whose width is set from the prior cycle's arrival entropy, held in a vault of timing buckets; arrivals outside the window are dropped. Spoofing requires staffing the gale of staggered, low-variance send slots around the clock. An atlas of per-identity schedules makes each fabricated identity demand dedicated timing hardware and monitoring labor, so N sybils cost roughly N times the slot-maintenance effort.
